Name: Poise Pressure
Counterplay: Not every hit adds Poise; recovers after a spell without qualifying hits; elites and bosses have higher thresholds and shorter control, never full immunity.
Effect: At threshold, a brief stagger or interrupt.
Role: One shared meter for Force and tagged Static.
Trigger: Qualifying Force impact, or a Static hit explicitly carrying Poise.

Name: Knockback
Counterplay: Squishy softens it; Membrane reduces it while up; mass, anchoring and terrain matter. Collision payoff only on an actual collision.

Name: Corrosion
Counterplay: Visible bar; no timer, no stacks, no damage over time.
Effect: On a Shell creature, a full bar strips one layer for good and resets. Any creature can carry it; it is the "Acid-coated" state reactions use.
Trigger: Acid hits, or standing in an Acid Pool.

Name: Charge
Counterplay: Charge decay, fixed jump limit, diminishing damage. Not a guaranteed interrupt.
Effect: Transfers a bounded hit or interrupts a tagged action.

Name: Snared
Counterplay: Short duration; one clear control strength per effect.
Effect: Slows movement ("Mucus-stuck" and "Adhered" mean the same). Becoming Snared clears a Burn bar.
Role: Mucus's main control state; smothers Fire.
Trigger: A Mucus hit lands, or a creature enters a Mucus patch.

Name: Conjoined
Counterplay: Capped group size; short; needs two or more creatures.
Effect: Snared creatures stuck together in one shared membrane: none can move, and they may hit each other.
Trigger: Two Snared creatures touch, or one Mucus attack's area covers several at once.

Name: Bleed
Counterplay: Stack cap and decay; Squishy and Shell do not reduce Bleed ticks.
Effect: Damage over time; a named finisher may consume it. A creature dying while bleeding leaves a small blood pool.

Name: Extraction
Counterplay: Not a reward on every Blood tick; cap it and prevent repeat-hit farming.
Effect: A small, capped amount of sustain.
Trigger: A named Blood attack hits, or consumes a wound.

Name: Possessed
Counterplay: Clear duration and tell; cooldown before it can repeat; elites shorter; bosses reduced, never fully controlled. The player is exempt.
Effect: The enemy fights its own mates for a few seconds. All five Soul reactions trigger on it.

Name: Fear
Counterplay: Fear-tagged effects only, not all Soul damage. Duration cap and recovery.
Effect: One specified effect such as panic, retreat or hesitation.
Trigger: An attack explicitly tagged Fear lands.

Name: Burning
Counterplay: No spread except through reactions. Becoming Snared puts it out. Squishy and Shell do not reduce it.
Effect: Fills a visible Burn bar with a short damage over time; at full, Ignition.
Trigger: A Fire hit lands, or a creature stands in a Fire Pool.

Name: Ignition
Counterplay: Resets the bar after it fires; never spreads to other targets.

Name: Status Build-up
Counterplay: Visible bar; no hidden stacks. A missed hit applies nothing.
Effect: Corrosion, Burn and Soul build-up all fill a visible bar toward one payoff.
Role: One shared shape for build-up states.
Trigger: Repeated qualifying hits or continued exposure.

Name: Interruption
Counterplay: Heavy actions and bosses may need a Poise threshold. No stun-lock.
Effect: Cancels or briefly delays a telegraphed action.
Trigger: A qualifying hit during a vulnerable window, or a full Poise meter.

Name: Conductivity / Chain
Counterplay: Visible jump limit; a pool pulse stays inside the pool edge.
Effect: An arc jumps to a limited number of targets, or one pulse crosses a pool.
Trigger: Static hits an eligible target or conductive pool.

Name: Acid Pool
Counterplay: Visible edge and lifetime; never indefinite.
Effect: The only ongoing Acid damage; builds Corrosion on anything inside.
Trigger: Acid Pool weapon, Acid Bubble, Slick Move.

Name: Mucus patch
Effect: Snares what enters it; ingredient for Slick Move, Sticky Situation, Flammable Mucus.
Trigger: Mucus Pool weapon, Snot Bubble, Snot Rocket.

Name: Blood pool
Effect: Ingredient for Blood Circuit and Caught in the Clot.
Trigger: A creature dies while bleeding; Blood Pool weapon; Mosquito.

Name: Wax Pool
Counterplay: Short-lived; the one justified Carrier exception.
Effect: Hardens into a temporary wall that blocks movement and shots.
